correctness.rationale: Weyl conjugation diagonalizes full complex operator tomography: one nonzero column per nonzero ambiguity coefficient. Every nonzero Sidon shift contains exactly two support points, so a pair contributes N nonzero characters unless its phase ratio is a fourth root, in which case precisely N/2 survive; all N zero-shift coefficients are nonzero since odd k gives an odd sum of character signs. Thus rank=N(1+binom(k,2)-B/2) and all kernel Weyl labels are explicitly determined. Root-of-unity alphabet collision classes number r=L/gcd(L,4); balancing occupancies uniquely minimizes B. The inverse-hyperbola sum recovers the quadratic polynomial with roots t,t' proving Sidon for every q=2^m. Independently recomputed complex ambiguity coefficients for all shifts and all characters at q=4 and q=8 under L=1,4,q-1,2(q-1), matching eight rank/collision predictions. These finite checks do not prove general q.
